system.description:
The Gungans are omnivorous humanoids native to the swamps of Naboo. Technologically advanced, they rely mostly on biotech, growing instead of building their homes and production facilities.

While their culture is peaceful, it evolved from a series of long, bloody clan wars, and Gungans still admire strength and cunning. Most communities are devoted to farming or manufacturing goods that are then traded to other Gungan settlements, but they will reluctantly trade with the Humans of Naboo.

Gungan Characteristics

Personality: Gungans tend to be inquisitive, cautious, and suspicious.

Physical Description: Gungans range from 1.6 to 2 meters tall, with two eyestalks, floppy ears, and long tongues.

Age Groups: Gungans age at the following stages:

CHILD YOUNG ADULT ADULT MIDDLE AGE OLD VENERABLE
1-12 Years 13-15 Years 16-35 Years 36-54 Years 55-64 Years 65+ Years

Homeworld: The serene world of Naboo.

Languages: Gungans speak, read, and write both Gunganese and Basic.

Example Names: Fassa, Jar Jar, Rugor, Tarpals, Toba, Tobler Ceel, Yoss.

Adventurers: Many Gungans leave their underwater cities to explore as Scouts. Since the treaty with the Humans of Naboo, some Gungans- perhaps driven by an impulse to regain the warrior spirit of old as Soldiers- have taken a larger step into galactic society.

Gungan Species Traits

Gungans share the following Species Traits:

Additional Gungan Species Feats

Gungan characters have access to the following Species Feats. No Species Feats are considered Bonus Feats for any Heroic Class.

SPECIES FEAT BENEFITS
Gungan Weapon Master Increase the die type when adding Force Points to attacks with an Atlatl or Cesta.
Perfect Swimmer Reroll Swim checks, always keeping the better result.
Warrior Heritage Gain a bonus to Will Defense when using an Atlatl or Cesta.

traits.name: Expert Swimmer
traits.description: A being may choose to reroll any Swim check, but the result of the reroll must be accepted, even if it is worse. In addition, a being may choose to Take 10 on Swim checks, even when distracted or threatened.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: A being can hold his or her breath for a number of rounds equal to 25 times his or her Constitution score before needing to make Endurance checks to hold his or her breath.

traits.description: A being has a swim speed of #payload#.
